t: A two-armed humanoid research robot with open Python and ROS 2 software.
steps: Contact Pollen Robotics by email for a quote and pick one or two arms on a fixed or mobile base.
Read the Pollen docs site and the getting started guide for the SDK.
Install Python and the reachy2-sdk package on your own computer.
Try the MuJoCo simulation first and practice simple arm moves there.
Power on the real robot and connect to it over your lab network.
Run a first tutorial from the Reachy 2 tutorials repo, such as moving one arm.
Install the VR teleoperation app to drive the robot by hand.
